metadata.title: LifeRescue agent assignment registry (control-plane document)
metadata.source: Jira project KAN (https://liferescue.atlassian.net), live read-back of KAN-4..KAN-55 on 2026-10-03 (read-only); bootstrap docs (HANDOFF.md, pm-reconciliation-report.md, gates-report.md, open-decisions.md, jira-backlog-draft.md) and baseline docs 16-20; ADR-0001. Analysis artifacts: bootstrap/analysis/ (issues.json, pm-review-package.md, dependency-graph.md, readiness-report.md).
metadata.jira_remains_authoritative: Jira remains authoritative for status, assignee, links and acceptance criteria. This file is a derived routing/readiness proposal, not a source of requirements. If this file and Jira disagree, Jira wins and this file must be regenerated. Nothing here was written to Jira.
metadata.status: PROPOSAL - requires human review (Ojas) and LR-11 review before use; do not merge without human review. 'readiness' values are the analyst's gate assessment, NOT human approval; Jira label pm-reconciled means agent-checked only.
metadata.numbering_note: Registered agent numbering is used: LR-01 Orchestrator, LR-02 Product Manager, LR-03 Architect, LR-04 Backend, LR-05 Frontend, LR-06 Agent Engineer, LR-07 QA/Evaluation, LR-08 Security, LR-09 Red Team, LR-10 SRE/DevOps, LR-11 Code Reviewer, LR-12 Documentation, LR-13 Release Manager, LR-14 Autonomous Ops. The originating prompt numbered Release as LR-12 and Documentation as LR-13; the registered numbering (LR-12 = Documentation, LR-13 = Release Manager) is authoritative here.
metadata.wave_naming_note: execution_wave (0-5) is unrelated to the 'Wave 1' activation list in docs/workforce/agent-registry.md (agents LR-02/03/04/07/08). 0 governance (LR-02/03/08/11/12), 1 foundation (LR-04/05/06/07/10), 2 core product, 3 hardening, 4 release, 5 hackathon submission. KAN-54 is placed in wave 0 (deliberate deviation from 5) because the hackathon intake constrains KAN-38 and KAN-50. Containers (KAN-4..16) carry the lowest wave of their children; they are not execution units.

field_definitions.primary_agent: Single agent responsible for the work (no two agents implement the same issue). Non-binding proposal; Jira assignee is currently empty for all 52 issues.
field_definitions.review_agents: Ordered independent reviewers (QA, code review, architecture, security as applicable). Never includes the primary agent.
field_definitions.security_agent: Agent doing the security review (LR-08) or null if no security trigger.
field_definitions.red_team_agent: LR-09 for agentic items with untrusted input, tools, approvals or side effects, else null. Red team attacks; it does not implement.
field_definitions.dependencies: Jira 'Blocks' inbound links read live (the blocker issue keys). Exactly what Jira holds today, including links this analysis questions.
field_definitions.readiness: One of needs_pm_review, needs_architecture, needs_security, ready, in_progress, blocked, in_review, validation, ready_for_release, released, done. First unmet gate in the order PM -> architecture -> security -> dependency. Containers are needs_pm_review (no AC / Definition of Ready).
field_definitions.blocked_by: Open Jira blockers (KAN-nn) plus non-Jira tokens: PM:Qn (PM question n in pm-review-package.md), DECISION:C-nn or DECISION:<name> (open human decision, bootstrap/open-decisions.md), ADR:<name> (ADR to be proposed by LR-03 and approved), DOC:<name> (missing baseline document), EXTERNAL:<name>, HOLD:<name> (standing user hold).
field_definitions.parallelizable: true if the issue has no inbound Jira Blocks link and is not a container, i.e. it could run in parallel with other work once its non-Jira gates clear. It does NOT mean it can start now; see readiness.
field_definitions.architecture_required: New service/API/schema/events/integration/auth/agent runtime/model or tool gateway/retention/async/infra boundary: LR-03 design or ADR needed before implementation.
field_definitions.security_review_required: Triggers: auth, PII, incident data, external APIs, AI agents, tools, credentials, messaging, side effects, uploads, untrusted content, model I/O, storage.

Ready for LR-02 to DRAFT only: mission, non-goals, target users, safety principles from docs 16-20/HANDOFF; every statement not derivable becomes a question for Ojas (no invented requirements). AC1 'mission approved' needs human approval. Product Constitution is a missing baseline doc.

Ready: doc 19 step 8 defines this as the first Architect task. Deliver diagram, service boundaries, ADR index, technology decisions as PROPOSALS incl. ADR proposals for gaps in pm-review-package (transition table, data-model gaps, lifecycle mapping). No code. Overlaps KAN-30 AC2. docs/adr exists only on PR #1 branch, so stack on or wait for PR #1 per human decision.

In review: deliverables exist on PR #1 (ojas005/liferescue#1; open, 2 commits, 26 files, 0 reviews at read-back) - pending LR-11 review and human merge; Jira status still To Do (not synchronized). Jira link 'KAN-20 blocks KAN-19' is questioned (dependency analysis). Format/lint/typecheck/test jobs are conditional and skip until code exists.

Scope (doc 19 step 10 / doc 20 Phase A) far exceeds its 4 given AC, which overlap KAN-24/KAN-25 (umbrella vs parts). Needs ADR workforce runtime (C-14, C-17). Highest-risk workforce item: tools, credentials, untrusted Jira/Git content. Backend hold.

Threat model (AC1) needs no code and is a missing baseline doc; AC2-4 need KAN-19 CI. Proposal for Ojas: pull AC1 into Wave 0 for LR-08 (split). Owner is the security agent: independent review LR-03 + human approval for policy changes (doc 16 s15). Secret scanning/Dependabot disabled on current plan (C-20).

AC clear and testable (schema validation). Needs ADR workforce runtime and KAN-21. At least 9 of 19 doc 16 s4 fields are TBD in agent-registry (C-22): AC tests field presence only. Backend hold.

AC testable. Needs KAN-24, KAN-19, retry policy values (TBD). Handles untrusted PR/CI content; git credentials need security review; no main push or branch-protection changes (doc 16 s9). Backend hold.

Security-defined controls: needs threat model (KAN-22) and the human-approval list (C-16 superset vs doc 16 s15). Gates must be non-bypassable by agents (red team). Depends KAN-24, KAN-25. Backend hold.
PM-blocked (Q3): quality/correctness/security metric definitions missing; 'computed from recorded runs' not stated in docs. Depends KAN-25. Owner LR-07: LR-07 must not review it.

PM-blocked (Q4): Wave 1 membership (C-03/C-13/C-14) is Ojas's decision; 'bots exist with registry entries' undefined while at least 9 of 19 required fields are TBD. AC2 duplicates KAN-18 (doc 19 step 8). Owner label LR-01 Orchestrator; human approval required.

AC clear and testable; rate-limit values TBD. Needs KAN-36, KAN-40. Single governed boundary for external actions: bypass tests (red team), egress restrictions.
